about.hero_title: A trusted marketplace for India's farmers, buyers and sellers
about.hero_desc: Fasal Junction connects crop trade with live mandi rates, verified enquiries and a simpler way to buy and sell produce.
about.story_title: Built to make crop trade fair, fast and local
about.story_p1: Farmers often sell without knowing today's rate. Buyers spend time chasing lots that are already gone. Fasal Junction brings both sides onto one platform so quantity, variety, location and price are clear before anyone agrees a deal.
about.story_p2: From first enquiry to verified contact, the goal is simple: fewer middle steps, better information, and a marketplace that works as well on a phone as it does in the mandi.
about.mission_desc: Give every farmer and trader a trusted place to post, compare rates and close crop deals with confidence.
about.vision_desc: Become India's most used crop marketplace, where mandi prices and verified enquiries sit side by side.
about.promise_desc: Free to post, clear lot details, and live rates before you agree a price — with support when you need it.
about.offer_buy_sell_desc: Post a crop or purchase enquiry with variety, quantity and location.
about.offer_mandi_desc: Check today's rate before you negotiate so the deal stays fair.
about.offer_listings_desc: See farmer details, buyer views and lot photos in one card.
about.offer_directory_desc: Find farmers, buyers and manufacturers by crop and region.
about.offer_guides_desc: Practical kisan stories, yojana notes and crop how-tos.
about.offer_mobile_desc: Trade on the go with the same enquiry flow on your phone.
